completed_phases.name: Setup and Architecture Core
completed_phases.description: Initial layout, exception hierarchies, configuration structures, and common primitives.

completed_phases.name: Protocol Serialization and Transport Layer
completed_phases.description: Binary packet framing wrappers, JSON/MessagePack adapters, and asyncio TCP socket communications.

completed_phases.name: Communication & Messaging Core
completed_phases.description: Transport-independent MessageBus, dynamic MessageRouter registries, middleware chains, RPC tracking, and local EventBus.

completed_phases.name: Peer Discovery
completed_phases.description: Dynamic transport-independent peer discovery catalogs, announcement broadcasts, departure notifications, and lifecycle callbacks.

completed_phases.name: Cluster Membership
completed_phases.description: Deterministic transport-independent membership catalogs, state machine transitions, join/ack handshakes, and versioned snapshot synchronizations.

completed_phases.name: Heartbeats & Failure Detection
completed_phases.description: Decentralized node reachability status verification registries, periodic ping loops, timeout evaluation failure detectors, and EventBus monitoring integrations.

completed_phases.name: Distributed Task Scheduler
completed_phases.description: Deterministic transport-independent task metadata registries, prioritization policies, scheduling queues, and EventBus status notifications.

completed_phases.name: Distributed Task Placement Engine
completed_phases.description: Dynamic transport-independent node capability mappings, constraint evaluations, ranking metrics, and task assignment handshakes.

completed_phases.name: Worker Runtime & Execution Engine
completed_phases.description: Pluggable local execution backends (Thread, Process, Async), worker registries, execution context isolations, and EventBus progress signals.

completed_phases.name: Distributed Result Collection & Completion Pipeline
completed_phases.description: Transport-independent result collection systems, serialization layers, registry catalogs, duplicate suppression mechanisms, and async completion tracking waiters.

completed_phases.name: Distributed Retry & Recovery Engine
completed_phases.description: Backoff policy evaluations (Fixed, Linear, Exponential Jitter), active recovery plans tracking, and placement engine failovers.

completed_phases.name: Distributed Raft Consensus Engine
completed_phases.description: Complete Raft consensus implementation: ConsensusLog, RaftStateMachine, ElectionEngine, ReplicationEngine, ConsensusService. 8 protocol extensions, 13 Pydantic models, 7 typed exceptions. 98 tests, 0 failures, 0 mypy errors.

completed_phases.name: Replicated Distributed State Machine & Metadata Store
completed_phases.description: Transforms Raft Consensus into a replicated metadata state machine applying PUT, UPSERT, INCREMENT, set, map, and array operations. Validates checksums, guarantees idempotency across duplicate command retries, and generates snapshot structures.

completed_phases.name: Distributed Snapshot Replication & Log Compaction
completed_phases.description: Introduces log compaction to bound Raft log sizes, along with chunked transfer segments for high-throughput snapshot replication, atomic state restorations, and InstallSnapshot protocol handler configurations.

completed_phases.name: Persistent Storage Engine & Write-Ahead Logging (WAL)
completed_phases.description: Provides durable crash safety across processes by enforcing atomic temp-rename swaps on disk writes, segment-rotated Write-Ahead Logs (WAL) with SHA-256 validation, and checkpoint-reconstructed recovery pipelines.

completed_phases.name: Distributed Observability, Metrics & Telemetry Framework
completed_phases.description: Introduces a transport-independent telemetry subsystem comprising thread-safe counters and percentile histograms, Prometheus exposition format exports, tracing spans context propagation, and event-driven health monitors.

completed_phases.name: Distributed Security, Authentication & Authorization Framework
completed_phases.description: Introduces cryptographic signing verification, trusted node certificate identities, role-based authorization (RBAC) permissions evaluations, HMAC-validated SessionTokens, and mutual nonced challenges join handshakes.

completed_phases.name: Distributed Resource Manager & Intelligent Cluster Load Balancer
completed_phases.description: Provides resource allocation, reservation leases, capacity planners, quota controllers, load skews, and Best-Fit/Least-Utilized load-balancing heuristics.

completed_phases.name: Autonomous Cluster Orchestrator & Self-Healing Scheduler
completed_phases.description: Introduces policy-guided scheduling, task migration transactions, load optimization algorithms, and autoscaling thresholds.

completed_phases.name: Multi-Cluster Federation & Global Scheduler
completed_phases.description: Introduces multi-cluster registration handshakes, capacity-aware routing strategies, global task schedulers, replication engines, and failover pathways.

completed_phases.name: Distributed Workflow Engine & DAG Orchestration
completed_phases.description: Introduces DAG cycle validation engines, topological planners, progress checkpointing to file storage, and execution pipelines.

completed_phases.name: Distributed Scheduling, Cron Engine & Event-Driven Automation
completed_phases.description: Introduces cron parser engines, EventBus pattern matching triggers, Raft leadership-owned dispatchers, and registry maps.

completed_phases.name: Distributed Event Streaming, Message Broker & Pub/Sub Framework
completed_phases.description: Provides partitioned topics, consistently-hashed publishers, committed offset trackers, rate backpressure controllers, and base64 storage persistence.

completed_phases.name: Distributed API Gateway, REST/gRPC Interface & Developer SDK Framework
completed_phases.description: Provides HTTP routing dispatchers, request validators, response JSON serializers, authentication gateways, rate limits, OpenAPI generators, and SDK client wrappers.

completed_phases.name: Distributed Plugin Runtime, Extension Framework & Dynamic Module System
completed_phases.description: Provides dynamic plugin registries, manifest catalogs, loader lifecycle initializers, permission sandboxes, and dependency resolver pass validations.

completed_phases.name: Distributed Service Mesh, Intelligent Networking & Traffic Management Framework
completed_phases.description: Provides service registers, weighted traffic routers, failure tracking circuit breakers, Round Robin load balancers, and discovery endpoints.

completed_phases.name: Enterprise Deployment Platform, Kubernetes Operator & Infrastructure Automation
completed_phases.description: Provides deployment registries, Compose/Kubernetes template compilers, topological task planners, rollout engines, controllers, and services.

completed_phases.name: Distributed Serverless Runtime, Function Execution Engine & Event-Driven Compute
completed_phases.description: Provides serverless function registries, isolated namespace Python code executors, triggers, invocation engines, metrics recorders, and autoscalers.

completed_phases.name: Distributed Data Grid, Distributed Cache & Object Storage Framework
completed_phases.description: Provides cache registers, transactional KV stores, object storage bucket quota validations, secondary field indexes, distributed lock managers, and lifecycles.

completed_phases.name: Distributed Query Engine, SQL Processing & Analytics Framework
completed_phases.description: Provides table catalogs, SELECT string parsers, stage execution planners, predicate pushdown optimizers, aggregation reduction engines, and service message routers.

completed_phases.name: Distributed AI Intelligence, Predictive Scheduling & Autonomous Optimization Framework
completed_phases.description: Provides machine learning prediction engines, predictive node planners, optimization engines, telemetry analyzers, anomaly engines, trend forecasters, and learning engines.

completed_phases.name: Enterprise CLI, Interactive REPL & Cluster Management Console
completed_phases.description: Provides commands registries, whitespace tokenizers, REPL variable stores, autocompletion matchers, formatting layout serializers, contexts configs, identity profiles, and session validators.
